feature_pool_definition: Intersection of the 46 MatrisomeAnalyzeR DEGs (|log2FC| >= 0.585 and nominal P < 0.05) with genes assigned to non-grey modules in the current dynamic WGCNA result

selection_method.LASSO: LogisticRegressionCV; L1; liblinear; 5-fold CV; accuracy scoring; Cs=[0.01,0.05,0.1,0.5,1,5,10]; selected |coefficient| > 1e-4; if none pass, retain the top max(2, floor(20% of input)) coefficients
selection_method.SVM_RFE: Linear SVC recursive elimination; top 10 features; step=1; no separate RFE cross-validation
selection_method.Random_Forest: 500 trees; balanced class weights; top 10 importance threshold (ties included)

performance_note: Feature selection used the full discovery cohort. These results do not estimate out-of-sample performance and do not constitute independent validation.
